description: This file defines a mock class template `MockStringIterator` for unit testing, implementing the interface `WPEFramework::RPC::IStringIterator`. It uses Google Mock macros to create mock methods related to string iteration.

classes.name: MockStringIterator
classes.description: A mock implementation of the `WPEFramework::RPC::IStringIterator` interface for testing purposes, parameterized by ELEMENT type and INTERFACE_ID.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Mock method to advance the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Mock method to move the iterator to the previous element.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Mock method to reset the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Mock method to check if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Mock method to get the total number of elements.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Mock method to access the current element.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Mock method for reference counting increment.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Mock method for reference counting decrement.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mock method to query another interface by interface ID.
